11	## Core Claims (3 条，可证伪)
12	
13	**Claim 1 — Format-Conditional Variance Structure**: LLM evaluation variance structure is fundamentally format-conditional. Knowledge-retrieval MC benchmarks (MMLU, ARC, HellaSwag) show item-dominated variance (42-49% item_id, 32-38% model:item), with negligible prompt/model main effects (<1%). Free-form reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH) show qualitatively different structure: model ability (15%), prompt wording (12%), and model×prompt (9%) emerge as major variance sources — not because items matter less in absolute terms (σ²_item comparable), but because new sources inflate total variance. This format dichotomy means MC and free-form benchmarks require fundamentally different reproducibility strategies.
14	**Cross-model finding (exp-001)**: Item_id drops from 61% (single-model) to 42% (cross-model) as model×item (34%) absorbs model-conditional difficulty. Item difficulty rankings are model-specific — single-model G-studies overestimate item dominance by conflating universal and model-specific difficulty.
15	**Cross-benchmark finding (exp-002, 921,600 records)**: MC benchmarks internally consistent (item_id 42-49%, no monotonic order within MC), GSM8K qualitatively different (item_id 12%, model 15%, prompt 12%). The structural shift is between evaluation formats, not along a continuous complexity gradient.

## 章节结构与数据

### §4.1 Single-Model Baseline (Llama-3.1-8B, 239,200 records)
- 6-facet G-study: item (200) × precision (3) × prompt (6) × seed (6) × temperature (3) × ordering (4)
- Binary correct: item_id=61.1% dominates; residual=19.5%; all main effects <1%
- Item-conditional interactions: temperature×item=6.9%, precision×item=7.2%, prompt×item=5.7%
- Text-exact-match: temperature dominates (79.7%), G=0.007 — unreliable at T>0
- Key point: item selection overwhelmingly dominates under binary scoring; methodology effects are item-conditional

### §4.2 Cross-Model Variance (4 models × MMLU, 345,600 records balanced BF16)
- Models: Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B, Mistral-7B, Qwen3-8B
- item_id drops 61%→42.1% [36.0-48.8%]; model×item=33.6% [28.4-37.9%] emerges as #2
- G_item=0.820 [0.782-0.861]
- D-study validated out-of-sample: 3-model predicted G=0.816 for n=4, actual=0.820 (Δ=0.004)
- Forward projection: 5 models→0.848, 8→0.893, G≥0.90 requires ~10 models
- Per-model interaction magnitude: Mistral 29.25% > Qwen 27.11% > Gemma 23.95% > Llama 19.69%
- Interpretation: item difficulty rankings are model-specific; single-model G-studies overestimate item dominance

Columns: Component | Variance % | 95% Bootstrap CI | Interpretation

Bold top-2. Include G_item=0.820 [0.782-0.861] as table note.

### §4.3 Format-Conditional Variance Structure [CORE — Claim 1]
- exp-002: 4 models × 4 benchmarks × BF16 × 2 temps (0.0/0.7) × 6 prompts × 6 seeds × 4 orderings × 200 items = 921,600 records
- MC benchmarks: MMLU item_id=42%, ARC=49%, HellaSwag=45%; model×item=32-38%
- Free-form: GSM8K item_id=12%, model=15%, prompt=12%, model×prompt=9%

### §4.4 Precision Separability [Claim 2]
- BF16≈FP16 (Δ=0.23pp accuracy); excluding FP32, precision effect drops to 0.0006%
- FP32 anomaly is vLLM enforce_eager artifact, not fundamental precision effect

- Multi-facet (432 conditions/item): G=0.918 at 200 items, G≥0.80 at 72 items

## 写作规范（硬约束）
1. **不用 em-dash (—) 或解释性 en-dash (–)**。用逗号、括号或拆句替代
2. **不用 -ing 短语结尾**（如 "..., demonstrating the..."）
3. **不连续用 Furthermore/Moreover/Additionally**：一段最多一个过渡词
4. **不过度分段**：自然段 5-8 句正常
5. **每个数字必须有 exp_id 来源**：不凭记忆写数字
6. **Booktabs 表格**：用 \toprule/\midrule/\bottomrule，禁止 \hline 和竖线 |
7. **Bold top results, underline second-best**
8. **小数精度全表统一**（1位 for percentages）
9. **Caption 在表格上方**
10. **figures 路径**: `figures/paper/fig1_cross_benchmark.pdf` 和 `figures/paper/fig3_dstudy_curves.pdf`（相对于 main.tex 所在目录的上两级，即 `../../figures/paper/`。但实际编译时 main.tex 会从 docs/paper/ 编译，所以路径写相对于项目根：`../../figures/paper/fig1_cross_benchmark.pdf` 或直接用完整路径。在 \includegraphics 中使用相对路径 `../../figures/paper/fig1_cross_benchmark`）

实际上，为了简单起见，figures 路径用：`figures/paper/fig1_cross_benchmark` （不含扩展名，LaTeX 会自动找 .pdf）。我们稍后在 main.tex 中用 `\graphicspath` 设置。所以在 experiments.tex 中，图片路径直接写文件名即可：`fig1_cross_benchmark` 和 `fig3_dstudy_curves`。

## 叙事策略
- 从 single-model baseline 建立 item dominance expectation
- Cross-model 引入 model×item 作为 "reveal"
- Cross-benchmark 展示 format-conditional dichotomy（核心发现）
- Precision separability 作为 confirmatory secondary finding
- D-study budgets 作为 practical contribution
- Robustness 简明扼要，增强可信度

## 引用
- 使用 `\cite{key}` 格式
- 可引用的 keys（已在 references.bib 中）：
  - mesting2026hidden, brittlebench2026, yuan2025layercast, sclar2024formatting
  - polo2024tinybenchmarks, hua2025flaw, shavelson1991generalizability, brennan2001generalizability
  - henderson2018deep, dodge2020finetuning, biderman2024lessons
  - zhou2026irt (PSN-IRT, AAAI 2026 Oral — for IRT comparison)

## 重要提醒
- 8-model expansion 数据未到，Table 3 中仅 4 models 数据，留 [PLACEHOLDER] 注释
- GSM8K ordering facet在 exp-002 中存在但对 free-form 意义不同，需在设计描述中提及
- 不使用 "significantly" 除非有统计检验
- 不使用 "state-of-the-art"、"novel"、"groundbreaking"
- 不使用 "consistently outperforms"（只有 4 benchmarks）
- Figure/Table 在正文中必须用 `Figure~\ref{}` / `Table~\ref{}` 引用
- 所有 \cite 必须是 references.bib 中存在的 key

## 章节结构与内容

### §3.1 G-Theory Background (~200 words)
- Universe of admissible observations: measurement = one observation from a universe of possible conditions
- G-study = variance decomposition: partition total variance into components for each facet and their interactions
- Henderson Method I: unbiased ANOVA-based estimator for balanced designs (cite Brennan 2001, Shavelson & Webb 1991)
- D-study = decision projections: predict reliability under hypothetical designs (different numbers of items, conditions)
- Key distinction from classical ANOVA: D-study enables **prospective** design optimization, not just post-hoc attribution
- Generalizability coefficient G: ratio of universe score variance to observed score variance
- Notation: use these symbols consistently throughout:
  - p = item (object of measurement)
  - M = model (crossed quasi-random facet)
  - π = numerical precision (BF16/FP16/FP32)
  - s = random seed
  - τ = sampling temperature
  - o = answer option ordering
  - δ = prompt template
  - σ²_x = variance component for facet x

### §3.2 Experimental Design: MMLU (exp-001) (~300 words)
- Fully crossed design: p × M × π × s × τ × o × δ
- p = 200 items, stratified 10 MMLU subjects × 20 items each
- M = 4 models: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Gemma-2-9B-it, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Qwen3-8B
  - Purposive sample from 4 major architecture families, treated as quasi-random facet
- π = 3 levels: BF16, FP16, FP32 (all with enforce_eager=True for fair comparison)
- s = 6 seeds: 42, 123, 456, 789, 1024, 2048
- τ = 3 levels: 0.0, 0.3, 0.7
- o = 4 ABCD rotations
- δ = 6 prompt paraphrases
- Total: 345,600 records (BF16 balanced subset for cross-model analysis); 239,200 for single-model (Llama)
- Note: Gemma-2 does not support FP16 (vLLM numerical instability); cross-model analysis uses BF16 balanced subset

**Table 1 (tab1_design_matrix)**:
\begin{table}[t]
Columns: Facet | Symbol | Levels | exp-001 (MMLU) | exp-002 (4 benchmarks)
Rows: Item (p), Model (M), Precision (π), Prompt (δ), Seed (s), Temperature (τ), Ordering (o)
Show fully crossed for exp-001, reduced for exp-002
Bottom: Total records per study

**Figure 2 reference**: `\includegraphics[width=\columnwidth]{fig2_design_diagram}`
Place in §3.2. Caption: fully crossed G-theory design showing 7 facets.

### §3.3 Cross-Benchmark Extension: exp-002 (~150 words)
- 4 benchmarks: MMLU, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag (MC), GSM8K (free-form)
- 4 models × BF16 only × 2 temperatures (0.0, 0.7) × 6 prompts × 6 seeds × 4 orderings × 200 items/benchmark
- 921,600 records total
- Explicitly described as "reduced crossing" (not fully crossed like exp-001)
- For free-form (GSM8K): ordering permutes few-shot exemplar sequences, not answer options
- [PLACEHOLDER: 8 models × 5 benchmarks when expansion complete]

### §3.4 Evaluation Protocol (~150 words)
- Generation-based scoring (not log-likelihood), per Hua et al. 2025 \cite{hua2025flaw}
- Dual metrics: binary_correct (primary) + text_exact_match (secondary)
- Default vLLM 0.9.2 settings (no batch-invariant kernels) reflecting practitioner conditions
- This means CUDA-level nondeterminism from floating-point non-associativity is a measurable variance source \cite{messina2026background, thinkingmachines2025batch}
- 5-shot for MMLU/ARC, 8-shot for GSM8K, 10-shot for HellaSwag

### §3.5 Binary Data Assumptions (~200 words)
- Standard G-theory assumes continuous normal data; our binary 0/1 violates this
- Four-line defense (cite each):
  (a) Simulation-based: probit latent → binary, ρ=0.732 ≈ continuous ρ=0.741 (Δ=0.009) under matched 1,296-condition design. Henderson I identifies item_id as #1 source in 100% of runs.
  (b) GLMM complementary: marginal logit ANOVA preserves all 7 grouped rankings (ρ=1.0) \cite{jiang2018bayesian, tuerlinckx2006glmm}
  (c) Bernoulli-adjusted: item_id% stable across accuracy range 0.62-0.72 (r=-0.048)
  (d) Henderson I unbiased for balanced designs (Brennan Ch.12) \cite{brennan2001generalizability}

### §3.6 Model-as-Facet Justification (~150 words)
- Purposive sample from 4 architecture families, treated as quasi-random
- D-study prediction validated out-of-sample: 3-model predicted G=0.816 for n=4, actual=0.820 (Δ=0.004)
- LOMO: all 3-model subsets preserve item_id dominance + model×item as #2
- [PLACEHOLDER: 8-model strengthens to ~0.893]
